default.description: Default capability for the RagVault window. The shell does all privileged work in Rust, so the webview needs almost nothing.

remote-spa.description: The SPA is served over plain HTTP from 127.0.0.1, so WebView2 treats it as a remote origin. This grants that origin the one privileged action it needs: handing generated PDF bytes to the shell so they can be written to disk.
